subject.title: message tool should auto-select the only enabled account

question: Should omitted message-tool account IDs infer a single enabled configured account after explicit/default/bound precedence, or should OpenClaw keep requiring an explicit `accountId` or `defaultAccount` when the configured default is disabled?
rationale: The implementation boundary is clear, but the requested behavior changes fallback semantics for existing multi-account configurations and should be accepted by a maintainer before the linked PR or a replacement lands.

options.title: Accept shared resolver policy
options.body: Land or replace the linked PR with a shared resolver that selects an enabled configured default account or exactly one enabled configured account, with clear zero-or-multiple errors.

options.title: Keep explicit account selection
options.body: Keep current semantics and document that users must pass `accountId` or configure `defaultAccount` when the default account is disabled.

options.title: Require channel-owned fallback
options.body: Ask for channel-specific behavior if maintainers do not want core to own omitted-account fallback policy across message channels.

recommendation.title: Accept shared resolver policy
recommendation.body: Land or replace the linked PR with a shared resolver that selects an enabled configured default account or exactly one enabled configured account, with clear zero-or-multiple errors.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already supplied the prior shared-resolver direction in the issue discussion and has recent account-helper and routing-doc history.
